description: The proposal involves a loft extension and refurbishment to an existing three storey single-family dwelling (ground, first, and loft levels). The proposals are to reconfigure the loft interior into an upgraded master bedroom suite with an ensuite bathroom and separate shower room while retaining the existing internal staircase. The scheme includes the erection of a full-width dormer extension strictly to the rear of the property, keeping massing below the existing main ridge line and introducing sliding glazed panels with glass balustrade to the rear façade. Externally, the existing pitched roofs and side dormer will be refurbished in matching red concrete tiles, two rooflights will be replaced, one new openable rooflight will be added to the existing side dormer roof, and the front elevation will feature a newly rendered gable and repaired chimney render. Additionally, a single outdoor air conditioning condenser unit will be installed set far back on the roofscape.
